name: National Overseas Scholarship Scheme for SC etc. Candidates (Applicable from the year 2026-27)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

rules.quote: facilitate the low income students belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes, Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans category
Bachelors Level courses in any discipline are not covered under the Scheme.
at least 60% marks or equivalent grade in the qualifying examination would be required
Not more than 35 (Thirty Five) years, as on first day of April for selection year.
Gross annual family income from all sources shall not exceed Rs. 8.00 lakh per annum in the last completed financial year

rules.value: unconditional offer from QS top-500 needed for round 1
rules.quote: Candidates having unconditional offer of admission to top 500 ranked foreign Institutes/Universities as per the latest available QS World University Rankings for the year 2026 only will be selected for grant of scholarship during the first round of selection.

rules.value: max two children per family; award once
rules.quote: Not more than two children of the same parents/guardians will be eligible for scholarship under the scheme
The candidate shall be precluded from availing any other scholarship
30% of the awards for each year shall be earmarked for women candidates.

amount.text: Annual maintenance USD 15,400 (GBP 9,900 in UK), contingency USD 1,500 (GBP 1,100), tuition at actuals, visa, insurance, air passage
amount.quote: Annual Maintenance Allowance 15,400 US Dollars 9900 Great Britain Pounds 2. Annual Contingency Allowance 1500 US Dollars 1100 Great Britain Pounds 3. Tuition Fees Actual as charged

documents.name: Admission document from foreign university
documents.quote: 8. Valid Document regarding admission in Foreign University

documents.name: Income documents of all family members
documents.quote: 9. Income documents of all family members

deadline.text: Round 1 portal April/May (40 days); round 2 September/October (40 days); selection year April-March
deadline.quote: The portal shall be opened for calling of applications for the first round in April/May for a period of 40 days
